_about: Hand labels for the plan eval: five arbisoft/workstreamai tickets whose change a person reviewed and merged, so the merged diff is the real answer. base = the commit the live run planned on (the fork point of its oneshot/ticket-* branch, read on the merge commit's first parent). must = source files the real change could not have skipped; ok = the rest of the real diff (tests, constants, max_migration.txt). A file outside must ∪ ok is reported, not failed: a plan can reasonably touch more than the change that landed. These iids are workstreamai's, so run with GITLAB_REPO_URL=https://gitlab.arbisoft.com/arbisoft/workstreamai and ONESHOT_WORKSTREAMAI_WORK_REPO pointing at a clone that has the oneshot/ticket-* branches (~/Desktop/workstreamai). Also set ONESHOT_WORKSTREAMAI_WT_ROOT, or the per-sample worktrees land in the ERP worktree root (they are removed after each sample either way).

28.why: Full stack: a backend helper plus the profile form's action, reducer and component. Catches a plan that fixes only one side.

29.why: Backend only. The fix lives in the chat platform view and a reminders helper, not in a model, so a migration here is wrong.

74.why: Small frontend fix in one shared component. The live plan added a Jest test, which the current prompt forbids.

123.why: The only case with a schema change: a new display_name field on the attachment model. Catches migrations: false on a model change.

179.why: A one-file style fix. The live plan also named five reminder and snapshot files the real change never touched, so this case is where scope sprawl shows.
